data.message:
The 'Max stamina for running' setting doesn't work. I have removed all mods to test this

-When holding SHIFT and running out of stamina at '0', if you let go of SHIFT and press again, it immediately allows you to run again no matter the 'Max stamina before running'.
Thank you for bringing this up. Ill look into it.
when increasing the maximum stamina cap, the stamina does not regenerate past the vanilla value (ex if set to 200% stamina will only regenerate up to 100% and stay there) any way to fix this ?
